subject: Order() sorts text differently on ShinyApps

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Order() sorts text differently on ShinyApps
parts:
Hello,
 I have a app. up on ShinyApps and all is working well. I have noticed one issue that surprised me. I have a list of plant names, some of which start with capital letters ("Norway maple") some of which start with lower case letters ("red maple"). I have done all of my coding using a windows desktop. I am using these names as choices in a selectInput. To put them  in the correct order I am using a variation on   

selectInput( inputId='myId", label="whatever", choices=c(Names[ order(Names) ] ) 

where Names is my list of plant names. On  my desktop this works fine, and sorts in alphabetical order as I expected. However when I do the same thing on ShinyApps, it puts all of the names that start with upper case letters first, and then the names that start with lower case letters. Why is this happening? I is some sort of encoding issue?  How can I fix this?

Thanks,
John Paul

messages.author: 8ffd6137fd43c6df
messages.subject: Re: Order() sorts text differently on ShinyApps
parts: How can I fix this?

Does this work as desired?  The vector that determines the sort order doesn't need to be the same as the vector that's returned.
selectInput( inputId='myId", label="whatever", choices=c(Names[ order(tolower(Names)) ] )
Why is this happening? I is some sort of encoding issue?
What is the collate order returned by Sys.getlocale(category = "LC_ALL") in the two machines?

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Order() sorts text differently on ShinyApps
parts: This is probably caused by the difference in platform/locale. ShinyApps run applications on Linux servers which have a different default collation.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Order() sorts text differently on ShinyApps
parts:
Yep, sorting is locale-dependent. For consistent ordering, you will
have to use the same locale, e.g. use Sys.setlocale() to set the
locale, do sorting, and restore the locale.
